title.zh: 伊朗革命卫队：今后将惩罚在霍尔木兹海峡以外区域违规的船只
title.en: 伊朗革命卫队：今后将惩罚在霍尔木兹海峡以外区域违规的船只

current_state.zh: Iran's IRGC said it attacked a liquefied petroleum gas tanker in the Strait of Hormuz hours earlier and declared it will henceforth also 'punish' vessels committing violations outside the Strait, without specifying what violations or penalties that covers.
